charts.title: Gross Profit, Operating Income & Net Income
Net Income vs Free Cash Flow vs Owner FCF
charts.annotation: Owner FCF, where shown, is the DCF's series after SBC, interest income and lease principal. Pipeline business divested in FY2020 -- FY2018-19 include it, FY2020+ are continuing operations only -- and FY2021 net income includes a one-off disposal gain on that sale.

charts.title: Consolidated Profit vs Attributable Net Income
charts.annotation: The gap is the minority shareholders' share of profit in Kunlun's part-owned subsidiaries -- about 37% of consolidated profit in FY2025.

charts.title: Liquid Cash vs Time Deposits (3M+)
charts.annotation: Together these two lines sum to the Cash & Equivalents card above; time deposits over 3 months are not available on demand.

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.content:
Shareholders' equity is assets less liabilities; plotted against total liabilities to show leverage.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): equity that grows only through revaluations or share issues is not the same as retained earnings.

What to watch:

  • Liabilities growing faster than equity
  • Goodwill share of equity after acquisitions

cashDebt.title: Cash and debt
cashDebt.content:
Cash & equivalents against total borrowings (leases excluded unless noted).

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): the DCF's net-debt bridge uses these balances at the latest balance-sheet date.

What to watch:

  • Net debt trend versus EBITDA
  • Refinancing dates and covenants in the filings

ebitda.title: EBITDA
ebitda.content:
EBITDA is earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation -- an operating-cash proxy that ignores capital intensity.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): read it beside CapEx: a business that must reinvest most of its EBITDA is not as cash-generative as the margin suggests.

What to watch:

  • EBITDA margin trend
  • Gap between EBITDA and operating cash flow (working capital)

epsDps.title: EPS and dividends
epsDps.content:
EPS is net income per share; DPS is the cash dividend paid per share. Both are in major currency units.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): the payout ratio (DPS / EPS) shows how much of earnings is returned versus reinvested.

What to watch:

  • EPS growth versus net income growth (dilution)
  • Dividends funded from earnings, not debt

fcf.title: Free cash flow
fcf.content:
Reported FCF is operating cash flow less capital expenditure. Owner FCF (from the DCF) further deducts stock-based compensation, interest income and lease principal -- the cash an owner could actually take out.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): the gap between net income and owner FCF is the earnings-quality question the valuation is built on.

What to watch:

  • FCF persistently below net income
  • Working-capital swings inflating one year's FCF

margins.title: Margins
margins.content:
Gross margin is revenue less cost of revenue; operating margin deducts operating expenses; net margin is after interest and tax.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): the spread between gross and operating margin is the cost of running the business; a widening spread with flat gross margin means opex is growing faster than sales.

What to watch:

  • Direction of operating margin over several years, not one
  • One-offs (impairments, disposals) that distort net margin

ocfCapex.title: Operating cash flow and CapEx
ocfCapex.content:
Operating cash flow is cash generated by operations; CapEx is cash invested in fixed and intangible assets.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): CapEx here is shown as stored (sign convention varies by ticker); the DCF splits it into stay-in-business and growth where disclosed.

What to watch:

  • CapEx rising faster than revenue
  • OCF that diverges from EBITDA

profit.title: Profit lines
profit.content:
Gross profit is revenue less cost of revenue; operating income deducts operating expenses; net income is after interest, tax and one-offs.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): the three lines together show where margin is made and lost between the top line and the bottom.

What to watch:

  • Operating income growing slower than gross profit (opex creep)
  • Net income far from operating income (interest, tax, one-offs)

minorityInterest.title: Consolidated profit vs attributable net income
minorityInterest.content:
Profit incl. NCI is the group's consolidated profit before splitting out what belongs to minority (non-controlling) shareholders; net income is the portion attributable to Kunlun's own shareholders after that split.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆䵑能源有限公司): Kunlun consolidates subsidiaries it does not wholly own (regional gas-distribution and LNG joint ventures), and minority partners' share of profit has grown to roughly 37% of the FY2025 consolidated total -- a widening gap here means an increasing share of reported group profit never reaches Kunlun's own shareholders.

What to watch:

  • The minority share (the gap between the two lines) trending up or down
  • Whether minority interest is concentrated in faster- or slower-growing subsidiaries

cashComposition.title: Cash composition: liquid cash vs time deposits
cashComposition.content:
The Cash & Equivalents balance-sheet total is split here into cash genuinely available on demand and time deposits placed for more than 3 months, which are classified as cash equivalents for accounting purposes but are not immediately accessible.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆䵑能源有限公司): in FY2025, roughly 13,329 of the 44,609 total was in time deposits over 3 months -- about 30% of "cash" that is actually locked up for a period, which matters for assessing true near-term liquidity and the cash available to fund the dividend or buybacks.

What to watch:

  • The time-deposit share rising (less liquid cash available on short notice)
  • Whether the split reflects a deliberate yield-optimization strategy versus a cash build-up with nowhere better to go

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.content:
Revenue is the top line: what customers paid for goods and services in the period, before any costs.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): the growth rate matters more than the level; compare it with the DCF's base-case growth path below.

What to watch:

  • Acceleration or deceleration in YoY growth
  • Whether growth is organic or acquired
  • Interim rows show seasonality

sbc.title: Stock-based compensation and share count
sbc.content:
Stock-based comp is the expense of equity awards; shares outstanding shows the dilution it causes net of buybacks.

For Kunlun Energy Company Limited (昆崖能源有限公司): the DCF charges SBC as a cash cost and holds the share count flat, so this chart is the check on that assumption.

What to watch:

  • Share count rising while buybacks are advertised
  • SBC as a percentage of revenue
